display_information.name: Arenza Alerts
display_information.description: Real-time AI visibility alerts from Arenza — wrong claims, SoV drops, competitor surges across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot, and Grok.
display_information.long_description: Arenza Alerts streams measurement-led GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) events from app.arenza.ai into your Slack workspace in real time. Get pinged the moment one of the 6 leading AI assistants misquotes your brand, when share of voice drops more than 10% week-over-week, or when a competitor surges in a market you care about. Configurable severity threshold, per-brand channel routing, and HMAC-signed webhooks. Powered by https://arenza.ai.
